reason: A more directly targets low friction across the full range through an intrinsically low-shear solid-lubricant phase, whereas CrN is primarily wear-resistant and its asserted low-shear, oxidation-resistant behavior at 800 °C is poorly justified. A still needs a defined load and evidence, and its claim of complete h-BN chemical inertness in air at 800 °C is overstated, but its mechanism and falsification test are more credible overall.
